answer: Each identity holds one lagoon plot and files a cedar-stamped report each epoch, paying tax rising with filings: first 40 credits, k-th 40+8(k-1). A sparrow receipt binds payer key to identity key; auditors recheck the lagoon ledger, and an unpaid filing or copied report burns the 70-credit bond. 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented-plot ring is flagged. Honest agents file once, pay 40, keep the bond.
